spots.name: Sully's
spots.description: Nestled in the Queen Anne neighborhood, we have been serving Seattle's best wings and pints of Guinness since 2007. Whether you're cheering on our Seattle home teams, catching up with friends and family, or simply avoiding life’s responsibilities, grab a cold one and some comfort pub grub with us. At Sully's, you're always family. Sláinte!
